purpose: Screen tests without a real terminal: keys, mouse clicks and the scroll wheel through NepScherm, for most of the program.
details: Defines the shared Basis (temporary data folder, speel() plays keys through App on a NepScherm and returns (screen, app), ergens() searches the frames) and helpers (hm, hm_klik, naar, plek, naar_spiekbrief, leerstof_vak, na_het_kader) that other test files import. Classes cover start, series, mouse, word problems, clock (also in the separate window using a NepKlokvenster), the fixed work method (klad, tips, second chance, 'Wil je stoppen?'), typing, the numeric keypad and the menu with letter keys.
module_docstring: Schermtests zonder echte terminal: toetsen, muisklikken en het scrollwiel via NepScherm.
